items.title: CNC Portal
items.description: Web portal for CNC. As a development team member, I work on integration and platform features.
items.note: Special note: a MetaMask account is required to sign in.
items.background: The CNC Portal gives entrepreneurs a way to create and run Crypto Native Corporations — companies that are distributed from day one and use cryptocurrency for both payments and governance. I work on the platform as part of the development team, on feature integration between the Vue front end, the Node backend and the smart contracts: wallet connection, treasury views, member management and on-chain voting. The hard part is making blockchain mechanics feel like an ordinary web app: signing a transaction should read as clearly as submitting a form.

items.title: Nova Graphik Visu
items.description: Showcase website for the Nova Graphik creative agency: services, portfolio, and team presentation.
items.note: Delivered and live for the client.
items.background: Nova Graphik Visu is a creative studio that needed a site matching the quality of the work it sells. I designed and built the showcase around three goals: present the services without jargon, let the portfolio breathe, and load fast on the mobile connections most of their visitors use. Built with Nuxt so the pages are server-rendered and indexable, with the content structured so the studio can extend it without touching layout code.

items.title: Designer Portfolio
items.description: Portfolio designed and built for a graphic designer: showcasing their creative work, services, and visual identity.
items.note: Delivered and live for the client.
items.background: A graphic designer needed a portfolio that put the work first and the interface second. The build is deliberately quiet — generous whitespace, a restrained type scale, and image handling tuned so large visuals stay sharp without slowing the page. Deployed on Railway with a setup simple enough that adding a new project is a content change, not a deployment project.

items.title: OrgaAfrica
items.description: Showcase platform for restaurants and local businesses: orders, payments, and queue management.
items.background: OrgaAfrica connects restaurants and local businesses with their customers: menus and catalogues online, orders taken remotely, payments handled, and a queue system so people stop waiting on site. I delivered the public showcase site and the back-office used by the businesses. The main constraint was the local context — intermittent connectivity and mobile-first usage — which shaped both the data loading and the interface density.

items.title: Pulse Score
items.description: Score and performance tracking application, currently in active development.
items.note: Live version online, development still ongoing.
items.background: Pulse Score tracks scores and performance over time and turns raw entries into something readable at a glance. The app is in active development: the data model and the charting are in place, and the work now is on history views, comparisons and export. Built with Vue and TypeScript, deployed continuously so the live version always reflects the current state.

items.title: WorkTogo — Alo Dowoto
items.description: Togolese services marketplace connecting clients with providers (cleaning, plumbing, electrical work…), built around escrow payments and an internal wallet topped up by mobile money.
items.note: Live version online, development still ongoing.
items.background: WorkTogo (Alo Dowoto) is a services marketplace for Togo, connecting clients with local providers — cleaning, plumbing, electrical work and more. The design problem is trust: neither side wants to move first. The answer is escrow — the client funds the job up front into an internal wallet topped up by mobile money, and the provider is paid on completion. Development is ongoing; the platform is deployed and the live version reflects the current state.

items.title: Page365
items.description: Daily micro-readings: finish a book in 3 to 5 minutes a day, sourced from Project Gutenberg, with excerpts delivered over WhatsApp.
items.note: Live demo online, development in progress.
items.background: Page365 is built on a simple bet: most people never finish a book, but almost everyone has three to five minutes. The app slices public-domain books from Project Gutenberg into daily excerpts and delivers them over WhatsApp, where the audience already is — no new app to install, no new habit to build. Built with React and Vite; the live demo is online while development continues.

items.title: Meet — Landing Page
items.description: Responsive product landing page, pixel-perfect integration with Vue.
items.note: Frontend Mentor challenge — build is live.
items.background: A responsive product landing page built to a supplied design, as a Frontend Mentor challenge. The exercise is precision: matching the design at every breakpoint, keeping the markup semantic, and handling the asymmetric image grid without hacks. Built with Vue.

items.title: Pomodoro App
items.description: Pomodoro timer for productivity, with customizable settings and themes.
items.note: Frontend Mentor challenge — build is live.
items.background: A Pomodoro timer with customisable session lengths, fonts and colour themes, built from a Frontend Mentor design. Beyond the visual match, the work is in the timing logic — keeping the countdown accurate across tab changes — and in persisting the user settings so the app reopens the way it was left.

items.title: Audiophile E-commerce
items.description: Multi-page audio e-commerce store: catalog, cart, and checkout.
items.note: Frontend Mentor challenge — build is live.
items.background: A multi-page audio e-commerce store: product catalogue, detail pages, cart and a validated checkout flow. The largest of my Frontend Mentor builds — the interesting part is state, keeping the cart consistent across pages and reloads, and getting the form validation to fail helpfully rather than just fail.

items.title: Frontend Mentor
items.description: My Frontend Mentor challenge solutions: pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible builds.
items.note: All of my published Frontend Mentor solutions.
items.background: A collection of my published Frontend Mentor solutions. Each one starts from a professional design file and ends at a build that has to match it: responsive at every breakpoint, accessible, and written to be read. It is where I practise the fundamentals that the client work then relies on.
